title: Ireland permits own-batch relief despite some licensed production
statusLabel: Held: mandatory certification may cure apparent difference
evidenceLabel: Current national scheme and guidance checked
deadlineLabel: EU application date; adoption due 31 December 2021
summary: Ireland excludes licensed batches from a small-producer excise reduction but allows some producers with licensed output to retain relief for their own batches.
euChange: New OFB relief uses a producer-level no-licence condition, with a small-cooperation exception.
nationalGap: Section 78 D(1)(iv) permits less than 50% licensed, franchise or contract output. Subsection 4(a) excludes those batches; it does not expressly exclude the producer’s remaining output. Revenue guidance repeats that design.
nationalLaw: FinanceAct 2003 section 78 D, inserted by FinanceAct 2024 section 69; operative 1 March 2025
consequence: Possibly, on paper: a producer using a genuine third-party production licence could retain relief on its own output. No recipient or incorrect payment has been identified.
resolution: HOLD: current APT5 note2 appears to direct every producer manufacturing for another under a licence or contract into Declaration2, which imposes the combined15000hl small-cooperation limit. Mandatory certification under current manual5.7 may therefore close the apparent residual cohort. Do not publish as an unresolved omission without resolving this route.
caveat: Mandatory certified APT5 is a material contrary route: note2 may require every licensed producer to use Declaration2 and satisfy small-cooperation limits. Its interaction with the less-than50% declarations and statutory wording is uncertain. This concerns genuine production licences, not all manufacturing contracts. No actual recipient, incorrect payment or Irish/EU judgment on78D has been identified.

comparison.before: Exclude licensed batches; allow less than 50% licensed production.
comparison.after: No licensed operation, subject to small cooperation.
comparison.note: Compare producers outside the qualifying cooperation exception.

review: Root independently read the national statute/current August2026 manual. Research personally read the whole APT5; verify independently accepted its note2 as a material adverse cure route. HOLD: no surviving current-entitlement cohort established, and no public missed-update claim recommended.
recognitionNote: Revenue openly describes the national partial-licensing policy. Bounded searches found no published analysis identifying this precise Irish OFB/EU producer-condition mismatch; this is not a first-discovery claim.

noveltySearch.method: Bounded official and public identifier, licensing and Court-case searches. General Irish tax commentary and Revenue policy descriptions were found, but no exact mismatch analysis.
